session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Big Gap Down, Sell Climax Then Major Trend Reversal' (ET+13 hrs, Mar 3/4, Mar 4 axis; inset Broad Bear Channel daily). Big gap down into a sell climax (2 legs down exhaustion, low 6742) with a double bottom major trend reversal, then a stair-step bull trend (shaded legs, bar 36-60) through the failed 6805 double top (reasonable shorts failed on the 5-minute chart, mainly limit order market), rally to the 6843-6845 measured-move double top and a late falling wedge into the 6825-6830 close.
